title: TROPICANA CHERRY | SATIVA
description_html:
Tropicana Cherry is a contemporary hybrid strain, resulting from the union of Tropicana Cookies and Cherry Cookies. This strain offers a delightful aroma reminiscent of dank tangerines and cherries, accompanied by a functional daytime high that’s perfect for various activities.

Ingredients;

Solventless 90u Ice Water Hash Rosin
